verdict.rationale: Yubico documents a public YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API for fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management, so the ordering and fulfillment part of provisioning can be driven programmatically. The evidence does not show API-driven user assignment or FIDO pre-registration, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. ykman only configures individual devices and is not fleet provisioning. Missing for 10: documented API support for assigning keys to users, documented pre-registration (pre-enrolled credential) workflows via API, a machine-readable spec, and hands-on or independent corroboration of end-to-end agent-driven provisioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive key provisioning end to end — ordering, assignment, pre-registration — through documented enterprise APIs instead of a human-only console

citations.quote: the YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API documentation is live and public at console.yubico.com/apidocs/
the documented programmatic surface for fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management
